purpose: Resolve whether two newly screened CAS specimen candidates can be added to the Taal research-scope file. Do not reproduce occurrence-level fields while source reuse terms conflict.

screen.assessment: The bounded GBIF screen returned two additional candidate records. A targeted provider catalog check returned four numeric catalog matches, including two Taal-labeled CAS-SU lots and two unrelated CAS-ICH lots. Collection code matters because catalog-number sequences overlap. Taxon names and record identifiers are intentionally not reproduced in this report.

rightsReview.gbifMetadataStatement: GBIF dataset metadata marks the dataset CC0-1.0.
rightsReview.providerTermsStatement: The current CAS Ichthyology collection terms say its databases and data are owned/copyrighted by, or licensed to, CAS; allow basic research, education, and conservation use; and prohibit repackaging, resale, or redistribution in any form. Commercial or for-profit use requires express written consent.
rightsReview.conflict: The provider's no-redistribution terms conflict with the broader GBIF CC0 dataset label for these provider-sourced records. No item-specific clarification was found that resolves the conflict for the two candidates.
rightsReview.disposition: Hold both candidates from tracked row-level research files, species assertions, public projections, map geometry, and reuse. Keep only this aggregate access/rights note until the provider clarifies the conflicting terms or an independent reusable source supports the same facts.

decision.rationale: Accuracy alone does not resolve redistribution rights. The project repository and any public app are not approved destinations for row-level CAS collection data while the provider-versus-GBIF terms conflict remains unresolved.

provenance.note: Raw responses were retained in ignored local research storage only. No row-level names or identifiers are included in this tracked report.

nextActions: Continue with independently licensed museum records or openly reusable freshwater surveys; do not wait on the CAS terms conflict.
Revisit these candidates only if CAS clarifies the terms for records distributed through GBIF or issues a written reuse grant.
nonClaims: The bounded query is not a Taal Lake checklist and its result count does not establish completeness.
No current presence, abundance, diet, catchability, safety, fishing access, legality, or geometry is inferred.
No specimen was physically examined or reidentified.
